insights.title: Seasonal Spike in Q4
insights.observation: Revenue peaks significantly in November and December.
insights.recommendation: Implement off-season loyalty campaigns in Q2 to stabilize cash flow.

insights.title: High Concentration of Value
insights.observation: Platinum segment contributes disproportionately to total revenue.
insights.recommendation: Launch an exclusive VIP program to increase retention.

insights.title: Electronics Margin Leakage
insights.observation: Highest revenue but lowest margin due to aggressive discounting.
insights.recommendation: Cap discounts at 15% for high-demand Electronics.

insights.title: Regional Underperformance
insights.observation: East region is underperforming by ~15% compared to targets.
insights.recommendation: Conduct market analysis for product-market fit in the East.
